about: What the shop's own items are worth used rather than sold. Our summary of the item tables in docs/re/PRODUCTION.md §9 and docs/re/WATER.md §8, with the use values those docs compute (§7 of each). base_value is the item's game unitValue before features, markup and events; use_value is credits gained per item (or per night/week/cycle for equipment and seeds) by the use, net of the other inputs where the docs give them; null when the docs give no number. when lists the shop states in which the use is open: any one alternative, each a '+'-joined conjunction of conditions (see catalogue.go). First matching entry wins, so specific ids come before general ones.
